profile.summary: A parent-teacher association (PTA) at Anthony Chabot Elementary School in Oakland, California, and a local unit of the California State PTA. It raises money through an annual fund and a spring auction, and coordinates volunteers. The funds support school programs such as art, music, library and science lab services.
